title: Stream Waterfall Height Transition
description: Original S02 static stream waterfall transition with a real 1.10 m water-level drop over a 2 m X run. One continuous closed editable terrain solid surrounds a separate connected closed water body with an upstream lip, steep falling face and widened receiving basin. Both end sections match the existing stream-width transition narrow port: bank-foot spacing .60 m, raw water width .72 m; downstream X=+1 water Z=.16 m, upstream X=-1 water Z=1.26 m. Old upstream placement is rotation Z=180 degrees plus translation (-2,0,1.10) m; downstream translation (2,0,0) m. Terrain union caps match within 2e-6 m. Water bottom edges retreat .01 m, retaining the old 20 mm paired V gap: water-surface continuity only, no full water-volume claim. Legacy earth/water PBR values remain on visible port-adjacent surfaces; hidden terrain cap material partition is not identical to the old separate bed/bank caps. Upper-end installation requires equally raised supporting terrain. The escarpment is a height-scale reference only; no cliff-side, bend or whole-scene exact snap. No added decorative rocks or vegetation. Static visual module only; no animated flow, hydrology, collision, navigation, walkability, support/load or physics certification.
